name: Beef Lasagna Noodle Soup with Carrots, Spinach & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add beef, carrots, and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until almost cooked through, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots
1 tbsp onion powder
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, break lasagna noodles into bite-sized pieces.

When the beef is done, add noodles, broth, and tomato sauce to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer until noodles start to soften, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1774 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce

instructions.primary_message: While the soup is cooking, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.

Add spinach and half of the basil to the pot (reserve remaining basil for serving). Return soup to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until spinach is warmed through and noodles are tender, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (454 g) bags frozen chopped spinach

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
